supporting_span: an individual who is married (within the meaning of subsection (a)) and who files a separate return
maintains as his home a household which constitutes for more than one-half of the taxable year the principal place of abode of a child
with respect to whom such individual is entitled to a deduction for the taxable year under section 151
such individual furnishes over one-half of the cost of maintaining such household during the taxable year
during the last 6 months of the taxable year, such individual's spouse is not a member of such household
such individual shall not be considered as married
rule: (married_living_apart_base_requirement_met(individual,taxable_year) AND married_living_apart_household_requirement_met(individual,child,taxable_year) AND married_living_apart_child_deduction_requirement_met(individual,child,taxable_year) AND married_living_apart_support_requirement_met(individual,household,taxable_year) AND married_living_apart_spouse_absence_requirement_met(individual,spouse,household,taxable_year)) -> NOT is_married_individual(individual)
